senses.gloss:
p. p. [सृज्-क्त] 
__1 Created, produced. 
__2 Poured out, emitted. 
__3 Let loose. 
__4 Left, abandoned. 
__5 Dismissed, sent away. 
__6 Ascertained, determined. 
__7 Connected, joined. 
__8 Much, abundant, numerous. 
__9 Ornamented; see सृज्. 
-Comp. 
-मारुत a. 
__1 causing the discharge of wind. 
__2 removing flatulence. 
-मूत्रपुरीष a. promoting evacuation from the bladder and intestine.

f. [सृज्-क्तिन्] 
__1 Creation, anything created; किं मानसी सृष्टिः [[Ś. 4]]; या सृष्टिः स्रष्टुराद्या [[Ś. 1. 1.]]; स्त्रीरत्नसृष्टिरपरा प्रतिभाति सा मे [[Ś. 2. 10]]; सृष्टिराद्येव धातुः [[Me. 84]]; [[Bhāg. 1. 19. 16.]] 
__2 The creation of the world. 
__3 Nature, natural property. 
__4 Letting loose, emission. 
__5 Giving away, a gift; सृष्टिर्मृष्टिर्द्विजाश्चाग्र्याः श्राद्धकर्मसु संपदः [[Ms. 3. 255.]] 
__6 The existence of properties or qualities. 
__7 The absence of properties. 
__8 Offspring (संतान); संसृष्टा ब्राह्मणैरेव त्रिषु बर्णेषु सृष्टयः [[Mb. 12. 60. 42.]] 
-Comp. 
-अन्तरः the offspring of intermarriage between चतुर्बर्ण castes. 
-कर्तृ m. the creator. 
-पत्तनम् a particular magical power. 
-सृज् m. (Nom. sing. सृक्-ग्-सृट्-ड्) the creator; [[L. D. B.]]
